autoDiscoveryEnabled.description: Enable/disable auto discovery of the URL.

host.description: Specify the host URL if the HTTP mode is set to `MANUAL`.

port.description: Specify the port if the HTTP mode is set to `MANUAL`.

packUrl.description: Specify PAC URL if auto discovery is disabled.

username.description: Specify a username if authentication settings are enabled.

password.description: Specify a password if authentication settings are enabled.
